title: Beef Dumplings in Indian-Style Gravy
description: A flavorful and spicy dish featuring beef dumplings in a rich Indian-style gravy.
instructions: To make the dumpling dough, combine 2 cups of flour and 1 cup of water in a bowl. Mix until a dough forms.
Knead the dough for 5 minutes until it becomes smooth.
Divide the dough into 8 equal portions.
Roll out each portion into a thin circle.
Place a tablespoon of beef in the center of each circle.
Fold the dough over the beef to form a half-moon shape.
Press the edges together to seal the dumpling.
Heat 2 tablespoons of vegetable oil in a pan over medium-high heat.
Fry the dumplings until they are golden brown on both sides.
Remove the dumplings from the oil and set them aside.
In the same pan, add the chopped onion and grated ginger.
Cook until the onion is translucent.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Stir in the tomato puree, bechamel sauce, cumin, coriander, garam masala, and chili powder.
Bring the mixture to a simmer.
Add the fried dumplings to the gravy and cook for 5 minutes.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
